relationships.evidence_quote: Mechanistic studies have shown that GBP treatment affects the downregulation of NR2B, and the downregulation of NR2B expression leads to the downregulation of TRPV1, pain-related molecules and inflammatory cytokines, thereby alleviating pain.

key_findings: Gabapentin reduces pain in adjuvant-induced arthritis mice and lowers NR2B, TRPV1, PGE2, substance P, cytokines and Ca2+ in foot and DRG
